"No kitten that loves fish is unteachable; No kitten without a tail can play with a gorilla;
Kittens with whiskers will always love fish; No teachable kitten

has green eyes; No kittens have tails unless they have whisters;
hence..."

Lewis Carroll

"Once you eliminate the impossible, whatever remains, however improbably, must be the truth."

Sherlock Holmes, Arthur Conan Doyle
